BCCE_POWER_APHONIA_POWER.title: Aphonia
BCCE_POWER_APHONIA_POWER.description:
At the end of your turn, gain 1 [gold]Dexterity[/gold] for each card in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
At the end of your next turn, lose that much [gold]Dexterity[/gold].

BCCE_POWER_MEMORY_POWER.title: Memory
BCCE_POWER_MEMORY_POWER.description: At the end of this turn, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] all Status cards in ALL your piles that have not already been [gold]Exhausted[/gold]. Gain 1 [gold]Strength[/gold] for every 2 cards [gold]Exhausted[/gold] this way.

BCCE_POWER_HELPLESS_WALK_POWER.title: Underworld Passage

BCCE_POWER_CHARGED_STRIKE_POWER.title: Charged Strike
BCCE_POWER_CHARGED_STRIKE_POWER.descript:
At the end of this turn, gain 1 [gold]Strength[/gold] for each {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} spent this turn.
Keep your accumulated [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
At the end of your next turn, lose the accumulated [gold]Strength[/gold] unless you [gold]charge up[/gold] again that turn.
BCCE_POWER_CHARGED_STRIKE_POWER.smartDes:
At the end of this turn, gain {Amount} [gold]Strength[/gold] for each {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} spent this turn.
Keep your accumulated [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
At the end of your next turn, lose the accumulated [gold]Strength[/gold] unless you [gold]charge up[/gold] again that turn.
(Will gain {StrengthAmounts:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold])

BCCE_POWER_HALLOWEEN_POWER.title: Halloween
BCCE_POWER_HALLOWEEN_POWER.description:
The next two times [gold]Osty[/gold] would take fatal damage during the enemy turn, heal him to 50% and 25% of his Max HP, respectively.
Playing Halloween again resets the remaining uses.
